<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Majin Buu''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu's House|Majin Buu's House]] in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Unlike most masters he teaches no plain skills, only six techniques of his own: one ki attack, two strikes and three evasion techniques. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:10-->
'''Other forms:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Evil Buu|Evil Buu]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Super Buu|Super Buu]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Buu|Kid Buu]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mini Buu|Mini Buu]] are enemies with pages of their own.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Buu lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu's House|Majin Buu's House]], which generates once per world in a plains biome. Every tier-5 Capsule Corp Assistant sells a map to it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu's House#Finding it|Majin Buu's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Techniques == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
{{See also|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
* '''Ki attack:''' Assault Rain
* '''Strike attacks:''' Gum Punch, Mystic Ball Attack
* '''Evasion techniques:''' Sleep Recovery, Candy Beam (5,000 TP), Gum Bind (9,000 TP)
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:9-->
They're paid for with Training Points. Anyone can learn them, but only Majins can equip or upgrade Gum Punch, the Mystic Ball Attack, Sleep Recovery, the Candy Beam and Gum Bind (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Evasion Techniques|Evasion Techniques]]). His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>
